summary: Overnight pharmacy technician with roughly a decade of hospital and retail pharmacy experience, including sterile IV and chemotherapy compounding, STAT order fulfillment, and emergency drug kit management. Certified and licensed pharmacy technician (Illinois) with an Associate of Applied Science in Pharmacy and training in pharmacy math, dosage calculations, unit dose preparation, and pediatric admixtures. Operates in fast-paced, high-acuity environments with strong inventory control, automated dispensing system (Pyxis) experience, narcotic controls, insurance troubleshooting, and HIPAA compliance. Background also includes prior customer service and cash handling roles.
